prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='THETA', seasonality_champion='ARIMA', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: THETA achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) while ARIMA leads in seasonality capture (0.5366), but ONLY_FT_catboost dominates overall RMSE (33.51). The extreme RMSE spread ratio (79.05) and high seasonality variance indicate significant model disagreement, making STL-hierarchical stacking ideal to exploit additive decomposition. Concept drift detected suggests dynamic weighting over static ridge fitting.
